==Trivia==
*These creatures were called Fenrir Spawn during the [[Guild Wars Eye of the North Sneak Peek Weekend]].
*Kveldulf means "twilight wolf" in Old Norse and "evening wolf" in modern Bokmål Norwegian.
*This creature has a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Kveldulf|version]].
*The cave where these creatures are located together with Fenrir in [[Norrhart Domains]] serves to farm [[Archaic Maul]] in regular quantities, it's one of the common items that they drop.
